query: When designing the user authorization module for the online diagnosis and treatment service system, which competitor platform's authorization process did the product team discover and primarily reference, believing it offered a clearer user experience?
gold: Hao Dafu Online
context:
[1] (about=Guoxin Pan, episodic, t44 @2025-01-28 10:18:05) Yes, I've found that 'Hao Dafu Online' has a very clear authorization process in terms of user experience. Through step-by-step guidance and easy-to-understand language, they effectively reduce user concerns. I've compiled screenshots of their complete process and interaction descriptions, which are very valuable for us in designing our own user authorization module. We not only need to be compliant but also make users feel safe and respected.
[2] (about=Huilan Chen, episodic, t44 @2025-01-28 10:15:20) Our product team has also collected user privacy policies and authorization processes from several mainstream online medical platforms both domestically and internationally. A common trend is 'fine-grained authorization,' meaning users can independently choose which medical record information to share with doctors. Guoxin Pan has made some specific findings in this regard.
[3] (about=Huilan Chen, episodic, t46 @2025-01-31 14:10:00) Received, Boss Zhang. I will also organize the product design team to thoroughly interpret it, especially the best practices for "granular authorization" and "privacy policy notification," to ensure our user experience is optimized while remaining fully compliant.
